about: Design skills this project was built with. frontend-design is vendored in .claude/skills (Apache-2.0). The rest are third-party and are installed from their own repositories by scripts/install-skills.sh or scripts/install-skills.ps1, so their authors' licences and updates stay with them.

install.name: impeccable
install.use: Design direction, critique, polish, audit. The main design skill.

install.name: emil-design-eng
install.use: Emil Kowalski's UI polish and animation philosophy.

install.name: review-animations
install.use: Review motion against a strict craft bar before calling it done.

install.name: prototype
install.use: Build several variants of one UI piece behind a picker.

install.name: apple-design
install.use: Fluid, physical motion and interface foundations.

install.name: make-interfaces-feel-better
install.use: Detail pass: shadows, radii, icons, micro-interactions.

install.name: oklch-skill
install.use: Colour work in OKLCH, contrast checks.
